title: Tiny, cute magic wand
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id='wand' x1='0' y1='0' x2='1' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#c9a3ff'/>
      <stop offset='50%' stop-color='#9b6bff'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#6a3fd4'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <radialGradient id='starGlow' cx='50%' cy='50%' r='50%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#fff6b0'/>
      <stop offset='55%' stop-color='#ffd94d'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#ff9f1c'/>
    </radialGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- wand stick, tilted -->
  <g transform='rotate(38 50 62)'>
    <rect x='45.5' y='40' width='9' height='46' rx='4.5' fill='url(#wand)'/>
    <rect x='49' y='40' width='3' height='46' rx='1.5' fill='#e2ccff' opacity='0.75'/>
    <!-- little grip bands -->
    <rect x='44.5' y='74' width='11' height='4' rx='2' fill='#5a2fa8'/>
    <rect x='44.5' y='81' width='11' height='4' rx='2' fill='#5a2fa8'/>
  </g>

  <!-- sparkles -->
  <g fill='#7ff0e0'>
    <path d='M22 30 l2.2 5.2 5.2 2.2 -5.2 2.2 -2.2 5.2 -2.2 -5.2 -5.2 -2.2 5.2 -2.2 z'/>
    <path d='M76 22 l1.8 4.2 4.2 1.8 -4.2 1.8 -1.8 4.2 -1.8 -4.2 -4.2 -1.8 4.2 -1.8 z'/>
    <path d='M30 15 l1.4 3.3 3.3 1.4 -3.3 1.4 -1.4 3.3 -1.4 -3.3 -3.3 -1.4 3.3 -1.4 z'/>
  </g>
  <g fill='#ffb3e6'>
    <circle cx='80' cy='45' r='2.4'/>
    <circle cx='14' cy='48' r='2'/>
    <circle cx='68' cy='12' r='1.8'/>
  </g>

  <!-- star tip -->
  <g transform='translate(50 32)'>
    <path d='M0 -18 L4.6 -6.2 L17 -5.6 L7.2 2.4 L10.6 14.6 L0 7.4 L-10.6 14.6 L-7.2 2.4 L-17 -5.6 L-4.6 -6.2 Z'
          fill='url(#starGlow)' stroke='#fff6b0' stroke-width='1.6' stroke-linejoin='round'/>
    <circle cx='0' cy='1' r='3' fill='#fffbe0'/>
  </g>
</svg>
